data.notes: November 2026 is especially strong for Sydney/Eora outdoor dance music, with Harbourlife, Anjunadeep Open Air, All Day I Dream, Lost Sundays and Manning Open-Air sitting alongside arena-scale pop and R&B tours.

events.title: Harbourlife 2026
events.summary: Harbourlife returns to Fleet Steps for a full day of house, techno and club music overlooking Sydney Harbour. The confirmed lineup includes Honey Dijon, Max Dean b2b Luke Dean, Ben Sterling b2b Omar+, HoneyLuv, Jordan Brando, Morgan Seatree, Bella Backe and Samantha Loveridge.

events.title: FORMA: Anjunadeep Open Air Sydney
events.summary: Anjunadeep Open Air takes over Tumbalong Park as part of FORMA with Eli & Fur, Dosem b2b HANA, Jody Wisternoff b2b Rezident, Catching Flies and Planet of Souls. The official program lists the event for Saturday 28 November and describes it as deep, progressive and melodic house.

events.title: Robbie Williams — BRITPOP World Tour
events.summary: Robbie Williams brings the BRITPOP World Tour to Accor Stadium with G Flip and The Lottery Winners. The stadium confirms the Sydney date as Saturday 14 November 2026.

events.title: Robyn — the sexistential tour
events.summary: Robyn brings the sexistential tour to Afterpay Arena on Saturday 21 November 2026. The venue confirms an 8:00pm ticketed start time.

events.title: ECHOES OF US
events.summary: Tang Events brings ECHOES OF US to White Bay Power Station with SIDEPIECE, Malaa, Marten Hørger, Matroda, Wax Motif, HILLS and local support. RA bills it as a large-scale electronic event spanning tech house, minimal tech and techno.

events.title: Nina Kraviz • ANNĒ • SHDW — Sydney
events.summary: Nina Kraviz returns to Sydney for a Manning Open-Air headline show with ANNĒ and SHDW. RA lists the event from 16:00 to 01:00 on Saturday 28 November 2026.

events.title: Jack Johnson — Surfilmusic Tour
events.summary: Jack Johnson plays The Domain with support from Ben Harper, John Butler and Emily Wurramara. The official artist page lists doors at 4:00pm and show at 5:00pm.

events.title: Daniel Caesar — Son Of Spergy Tour
events.summary: Daniel Caesar plays two Sydney arena dates for the Son Of Spergy Tour on Thursday 5 and Friday 6 November 2026. The venue lists an 8:00pm ticketed start time.

events.title: Carhartt WIP presents: Keys To The City
events.summary: Club 77 presents an outdoor day party at Fraser Park with Move D, Tarzsa, Deepa, Alex Diwa, Jun Wan, Mimi J, Fanatico Records and Lorna Clarkson x Simon Caldwell. RA lists the event from 14:00 to 21:30.

events.title: Heaps Gay OFFENSIVE TRADE
events.summary: Heaps Gay stages a three-stage queer and allies party in a heritage-listed industrial powerstation with Chippy Nonstop, Hercules & Love Affair, CCL, Amanda Lepore and more.

events.title: Khalid — It’s Always Summer Somewhere Tour
events.summary: Khalid returns to Sydney for an Afterpay Arena stop on his It’s Always Summer Somewhere Tour. The venue confirms Friday 13 November 2026 with a 7:30pm ticketed start time.

events.title: Joji — Solaris Tour
events.summary: Joji brings the Solaris Tour to Afterpay Arena on Saturday 14 November 2026. The venue lists a 7:00pm ticketed start time.

events.title: All Day I Dream of Australia | Sydney
events.summary: Lee Burridge brings All Day I Dream back to Australia with Lost Desert and Double Touch at ivy. Moshtix confirms the Sydney event for 2:00pm on Saturday 28 November 2026.

events.title: Honey Dijon - SYDNEY - MANNING COURTYARD
events.summary: Astral People and The House of Mince bring Honey Dijon to Manning Courtyard for a house night rooted in Chicago, Black and queer club lineage.

events.title: Lost Sundays — November 22 ft. Omar+, The Trip & Lewis Taylor
events.summary: Lost Sundays hosts a November edition at ivy with UK selectors Omar+, The Trip and Lewis Taylor. Moshtix lists the party for 4:00pm on Sunday 22 November 2026.

events.title: FORMA: Kool & The Gang + Sister Sledge ft. Sledgendary
events.summary: FORMA opens its Tumbalong Park season with Kool & The Gang, Sister Sledge ft. Sledgendary and Wrong Way Up. The official program lists the date as Friday 27 November.

events.title: TEKNO & Friends
events.summary: Afrobeats artist Tekno makes his Australian debut at Metro Theatre for TEKNO & Friends. Ticketek confirms the show for Saturday 28 November 2026 at 8:00pm.

events.title: Gilles Peterson - Liberty Hall COURTS - SYD
events.summary: Astral People’s Summer Dance series hosts Gilles Peterson with Kamma & Masalo and BRIA for a courtyard day party joining jazz, soul, broken beat, Brazilian rhythms, jungle, electronic music and diasporic club sounds.

events.title: Foo Fighters — Take Cover Tour
events.summary: Foo Fighters bring the Take Cover Tour to Accor Stadium on Tuesday 10 November 2026. The Sydney date is presented by Frontier Touring and Triple M, with The Belair Lip Bombs and TEENS listed as supports.

events.title: Jay Chou — Carnival II World Tour in Sydney
events.summary: Jay Chou brings the Carnival II World Tour to ENGIE Stadium in Sydney Olympic Park on Saturday 21 November 2026. Ticketmaster lists the show as the Sydney stop for the Mandopop star’s 2026 tour.

events.title: Charlie Puth — Whatever's Clever! World Tour
events.summary: Charlie Puth’s Whatever's Clever! World Tour stops at Qudos Bank Arena on Tuesday 10 November 2026. Live Nation lists the Sydney arena date as part of his Australia and New Zealand headline run.

events.title: Two Door Cinema Club with The Vaccines
events.summary: Two Door Cinema Club play Hordern Pavilion on Sunday 22 November 2026, with The Vaccines as special guests. The venue listing says Two Door Cinema Club will perform Tourist History in full plus greatest hits.

events.title: Courtney Barnett
events.summary: Courtney Barnett plays the Sydney Opera House Concert Hall on Friday 6 November 2026. The Opera House listing presents the show around her fourth album, Creature of Habit.

events.title: Death Cab For Cutie
events.summary: Death Cab For Cutie play Hordern Pavilion on Thursday 12 November 2026. The venue listing says the band will showcase hits alongside material from their forthcoming album I Built You A Tower.

events.title: Men I Trust — Equus Tour
events.summary: Men I Trust’s Equus Tour reaches Enmore Theatre Sydney on Friday 20 November 2026. Live Nation lists the Canadian indie-pop trio’s Sydney show alongside other Australian dates.

events.title: Homemade Saturdays - 14th November 2026
events.summary: Home Sydney’s recurring multi-room Saturday-night residency, billed as bringing house, party, R&B, hip-hop and EDM under one roof at Home The Venue.

events.title: Yeah Buoy - Sunset Boat Party (14.11)
events.venueName: King Street Wharf 3 North / Inception Cruises
events.summary: Sydney Harbour sunset boat party promising house, tech-house and disco across three levels, with rotating local and international house DJs.

events.title: TRPL8 Beach Edition Vol.1
events.summary: A daytime beachside TRPL8 house session with Melo, Davey Hanna and Mimi J, billed around Chicago house foundations, classic house, soulful vocals and funky grooves.

events.title: Delilah Bon | Australian East Coast Tour | Sydney
events.summary: A small-room Sydney date for Delilah Bon, whose self-produced sound blends nu-metal, riot grrrl and hip-hop with a strong LGBTQ+ and activist following.
